name: opendental
description: Connect Claude to Open Dental: schedule, patients, chart notes, treatment planning, lab cases, A/R, claims and production reports. Independent project, not affiliated with Open Dental Software.
long_description: Reads your Open Dental database through the official Open Dental API (cloud, API Service or Local API). Read-only unless you turn on "Allow changes", which lets Claude book, move, confirm or break appointments and add commlog and appointment notes after you approve each one. SSNs are removed from every result, and report queries are limited to read-only SQL.

developer_key.title: Developer Key
developer_key.description: From the Open Dental Developer Portal.

customer_key.title: Customer Key
customer_key.description: Your office's key, also entered in Open Dental under Setup > Advanced Setup > API.

base_url.title: API URL
base_url.description: In the office: http://<server IP>:30223/api/v1 (API Service). Outside the office: https://api.opendental.com/api/v1 (cloud).

api_plan.title: Open Dental API plan
api_plan.description: Only matters for the cloud URL; sets how fast Claude may send requests. Enter read-all (free plan, 1 request per 5 s), standard (any paid plan, 1 per second) or enterprise (Enterprise add-on, 1 per 0.5 s).

allow_writes.title: Allow schedule changes
allow_writes.description: Let Claude book, move, confirm or break appointments, add commlog/appointment notes, and create or update lab cases. Claude asks before each change.

allow_chart_changes.title: Allow chart changes
allow_chart_changes.description: Let Claude write clinical notes (unsigned group notes and addenda), enter treatment plans, chart procedures as complete/existing/referred/condition, and mark teeth missing, hidden, primary or permanent. Claude asks before each change and never signs.

max_rows.title: Max rows per request
max_rows.description: Upper limit on rows returned by one tool call.
